description: This file implements the ShareProductDropdownReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve options for lock-in period frequency types and minimum active period frequency types in the context of share products, likely for dropdown selections in a user interface.

classes.name: ShareProductDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShareProductDropdownReadPlatformService interface providing methods to retrieve dropdown options related to share product lock-in and active periods.

methods.name: retrieveLockinPeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of EnumOptionData representing allowed lock-in period frequency types (days, weeks, months, years) for share products.

methods.name: retrieveMinimumActivePeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of EnumOptionData representing the minimum active period frequency type (days) for share products.
